messages:
emma_acme: Hey, hitting a 403 in the console when I try to open Project 'atlas-payments' — I was in there this morning. Started happening right after our SSO changes. Screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/xyz (shows 403 page)

sara_support: sorry you're blocked, emma. can you paste the exact steps you took + the org/project id? also, are you using the org-level SSO or a per-project invite?

emma_acme: steps: 1) SSO login via Google SAML -> redirected to console 2) click Projects -> select atlas-payments 3) UI shows "Permission denied (403)". org id  org-98765, project id proj-atlas-01. I can still access other projects.

sara_support: thanks. can you try the CLI check for quick repro? run:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/proj-atlas-01/members
```
what do you get back?

emma_acme: ran it, result: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "permission_denied", "message": "You do not have permission to view this project" }
```

liam_idp: pinging in — looks like a SCIM/group sync delta after the SSO attribute change. our identity logs show a recent sync that dropped group::devs membership for a handful of users in org-98765. identity-bot just posted: 

identity-bot: SCIM SYNC: org-98765: 2026-03-12T14:02:11Z — WARN: mapping mismatch, incoming group 'devs' not mapped to any role; 23 members flagged.

sara_support: ok that matches the symptom (only this project affected). can you check the Project role bindings in the console? sometimes the UI will show an "orphaned" badge where a group mapping used to be. If you can't see, @liam_idp can pull the binding from the backend: `GET /orgs/org-98765/projects/proj-atlas-01/role-bindings` and paste result.

liam_idp: pasted minimal sanitized output: 
```
[
  {"binding_id":"rb-334","principal":"group:devs","role":"developer","status":"orphaned"},
  {"binding_id":"rb-400","principal":"user:ali@acme.com","role":"admin","status":"active"}
]
```

nora_security: flagged — "orphaned" means the group reference doesn't resolve to any current identity provider group (SCIM mapping changed). two paths: A) quick remediation: add the user directly to the project as a member or B) fix the SCIM/group-to-role mapping so group:devs resolves again. do we know if acme changed the SAML group attribute name?

emma_acme: yes we switched SAML attr from `memberOf` to `groups` last week. we thought SCIM would keep mapping but maybe not.

sara_support: that confirms it. short-term workaround: adding you explicitly to the project will restore access. run this (we can run it if you prefer):
```
redwoodctl projects add-member --project proj-atlas-01 --member user:emma@acme.com --role developer
```

emma_acme: can you do that? I'm blocked for a release.

ali_account: I can apply the manual add; doing it now and will audit after. tagging @nora_security for approval.

identity-bot: ACTION: added user:emma@acme.com to proj-atlas-01 as developer by ali_account at 2026-03-12T15:08:09Z

emma_acme: confirmed, I can access project now, thanks!

nora_security: long-term we need to update your SCIM mapping. liam, can you share the recommended mapping for the new SAML attr so group:devs resolves to role developer? also note: if the org had any explicit deny policies applied at org level those would still override. check `org-policy list org-98765` if there are deny rules.

liam_idp: recommended SCIM mapping snippet for Acme (examples):
```
// map SAML/GROUPS claim -> SCIM group 'devs'
{ "external_group_name": "devs", "idp_attribute": "groups", "role": "developer" }
```
Also ran a dry-run SCIM sync after the attribute change and saw ~23 users would be remapped — I can schedule a full resync once Acme's IdP confirms the attribute.

emma_acme: can you mark the ticket as high priority? release dependency.

ali_account: raising SR-6421 to account team and tagging customer priority P1 (release blocker). I attached the minimal repro (curl response + orphaned binding id rb-334).

sara_support: final checklist for followup: 
- liam: schedule SCIM full resync once Acme confirms SAML attribute mapping (assign ETA)
- nora: confirm no org-level deny rules that would still block access
- ali: keep customer updated and remove the temporary explicit member once mapping stable

liam_idp: put tentative resync for 2026-03-13T02:00Z UTC — will monitor and post result.

nora_security: confirmed `org-policy list org-98765` returned only audit rules, no deny policies.

emma_acme: appreciate the help, will coordinate with our IdP.

sara_support: closing thread here but will link the SR and ping when resync complete. if anyone sees other orphaned bindings in org-98765, please escalate with the rb-* ids. :thumbsup:
